name: IKI Small Grants

funder.name: German Federal Ministry for the Environment, Climate Action, Nature Conservation and Nuclear Safety (BMUKN)

summary: Grants from Germany's International Climate Initiative for small local organisations in ODA-eligible countries running single-country climate and biodiversity projects; the current call focuses on nature-based solutions and pairs funding with capacity development.

deadline.text: the application period will be closed on 8 January 2027

status.quote: The 8th IKI Small Grants 'Call for Proposals' will open on 15 November 2026 and the application period will be closed on 8 January 2027.

deadline.quote: The 8th IKI Small Grants 'Call for Proposals' will open on 15 November 2026 and the application period will be closed on 8 January 2027.

opens.quote: The 8th IKI Small Grants 'Call for Proposals' will open on 15 November 2026 and the application period will be closed on 8 January 2027.

administered_by.quote: IKI Small Grants is implemented by Deutsche Gesellschaft für Internationale Zusammenarbeit (GIZ) GmbH.

applicant_types.quote: Applicants should be not-for-profit organisations and private companies if they pursue non-profit objectives as part of their proposed project.

geography.quote: Projects must be implemented in countries that fulfil the criteria for Official Development Assistance (ODA) with the same exemptions for applying organisations mentioned under 2.1.

access.quote: The international call for proposals addresses local organisations based in ODA-eligible countries with an average annual revenue of between EUR 60,000 and EUR 500,000.

window.quote: The 8th IKI Small Grants 'Call for Proposals' will open on 15 November 2026 and the application period will be closed on 8 January 2027.

amount.quote: IKI Small Grants provides funding between EUR 60,000 and EUR 200,000.
